profile_text.body:
Chegg is a publicly traded education technology company (ticker: CHGG, CIK 0001364954) that describes itself as providing homework help and study support across more than 50 subjects, with 24/7 availability. Its site positions the service around step-by-step solutions, access to real experts, and high-quality answers refined by student feedback, offered through Chegg Study and Chegg Study Pack subscription plans.

The company's AI product is CheggMate, an AI study assistant categorized under education and research AI, focused on academic help. Chegg's own site references an honor code, which reflects ongoing questions in the education sector about academic integrity in AI-assisted learning. A survey fielded between September 9 and October 3, 2024, among a random sample of U.S. customers who used Chegg Study or Chegg Study Pack in Q2 and Q3 2024 drew from approximately 1,039,954 invites, with 712 respondents.

No litigation or MCP server records are held for Chegg in the site's current data. The company has maintained a verified profile on theworldofai.org as of August 18, 2026.
